subject: Upgrading to Business
body:
Hi there,

We've been on the Pro plan for about a year with 12 users and it's been working well. We're now at the point where we need the advanced permissions and the audit log that come with Business. A few questions before we switch:

1. If we upgrade mid-cycle, do we pay the difference right away or at renewal?
2. Do our existing projects and integrations carry over untouched?
3. We pay annually. Will the upgrade reset our renewal date?

We'd like to do this before the end of the quarter if possible. Our workspace is saltmarsh-media.ourapp.com.

Thanks,
Imogen Clarke
Operations Lead
need 3 more seats. how do i add them

subject: Downgrade to Starter
body: We're scaling back after losing a big client and want to move from Business to Starter at our next renewal. What features will we lose? Specifically I'm worried about our automations (we have about 30) and the client portal. Will they be deleted or just disabled until we upgrade again?

subject: Switch to annual billing
body: We've been paying monthly for 8 months and we're sure we're staying. How do I switch to annual to get the discount? Will I get credit for the current month I've already paid? Account acct_2r9fke

Hello, we are a school with 35 teachers using the free plan. The headteacher approved budget for the Education plan. How do we upgrade and does the education discount apply automatically, or do we need to send proof? Thank you, Mr. Adebayo

subject: Reduce seats
body: We need to go from 40 seats down to 25. I tried in the billing page but it says I have to remove members first. I've removed 15 people but the seat number still shows 40 and the minus button is greyed out. What am I missing?

subject: Monthly to annual + add seats
body: Two changes please: switch our plan from monthly to annual, and increase from 8 to 12 seats at the same time. I'd rather do it in one go so we get one invoice. Workspace ID ws_90156.

I'm on the Personal plan and I just started a small business with a partner. Can I upgrade my plan to a Team plan and invite her, or do I need a separate account? I'd like to keep all my existing projects.

subject: Plan change not showing
body: I upgraded to Pro an hour ago, the payment went through (I got a receipt), but my account still says Free and the Pro features are locked. Logged out and back in, no change. Email: femi.ogunleye@gmail.com

subject: Enterprise upgrade
body: We're currently on Business with 180 seats and we've been told by our account rep that we'd need Enterprise for data residency in the EU and a custom DPA. We're ready to move forward. Can you tell us the steps to upgrade and whether our contract term restarts? Org ID 12093.
Can I pause my subscription for 3 months instead of cancelling? Going on parental leave and won't use it, but I want to keep everything as is for when I'm back.

subject: Add-on for extra storage
body: We're hitting the 100GB storage limit on our plan. Is there a storage add-on we can buy without moving to the next tier? We don't need any of the other Business features, just space for video files.

subject: Moving seats between workspaces
body: Our company has two workspaces on separate subscriptions: one for the UK team (10 seats) and one for the US team (20 seats). We want to merge billing so it's one subscription with 30 seats. Is that possible? We'd also like to keep the workspaces separate, just pay once.

We downgraded to Pro last week and now I can't see any of the dashboards we built on Business. I know dashboards are a Business feature but I assumed they'd be read-only, not gone. Can we get read-only access or export them? Otherwise we'll have to go back up to Business.

subject: Upgrade + invoice
body: Please upgrade us from Team to Business, 15 seats, annual. Our finance team will need a formal invoice with our company details (Veldhoven Logistics B.V., VAT NL859234512B01) before they can pay, so please don't just charge the card on file.

subject: Switch from annual to monthly at renewal
body: Our annual plan renews in 6 weeks. We'd like to switch to monthly from then on, because we're not sure how long we'll keep the team this size. Can you set that up so it doesn't auto-renew as annual?
hi. i'm on basic. my team is 4 people now instead of 2. upgrade to team plan please. and do we keep our stuff? kirsty

subject: Adding seats for summer interns
body: We'll have 6 interns from June through August. Can we add 6 seats for just those 3 months and then drop back down, without being locked into a year for the extra seats? We're on annual billing. Workspace harlow-architects.ourapp.com

subject: Downgrade not taking effect
body: I downgraded to the free plan from Pro on the 3rd. The confirmation said the change would happen at the end of my billing period on the 15th. It's the 18th and I'm still showing as Pro, and I'm worried I'll get charged again on the next cycle.

Our nonprofit got a grant and we'd like to go from the free nonprofit tier to Business. Do we keep the nonprofit discount on Business, and can we upgrade today? We have a board demo on Thursday and need the reporting features for it.

subject: Plan comparison for our case
body: We're on Pro. We keep hearing Business would help with our client approvals workflow. Before we pay double, could you tell us which specific features in Business would help with approvals? And if we upgrade and it's not useful, can we go back down within the month without penalty?

subject: Increase seats + new admin
body: We need 5 more seats added to our subscription (currently 20), and once that's done please make our new operations manager, Rhea, an admin. She'll be taking over the account from me. acct_6v1cmx

Is it possible to have different plans for different people in the same workspace? Most of our team only needs the basic features but 3 people need the advanced reporting. Paying Business for all 30 people seems wasteful.

subject: Consolidate two subscriptions
body: I personally pay for a Pro subscription and my employer pays for a Business seat for me in their workspace. I don't need my personal Pro anymore since I get everything at work. Can I downgrade the personal one to free but keep my personal projects?

subject: Upgraded by mistake, want to switch back
body: Clicked upgrade to Business instead of just adding one seat to Pro. Can you switch us back to Pro with 11 seats? I don't care about getting money back, I just want the right plan. Workspace ID ws_33019

subject: Cancel subscription
body: Please cancel our subscription effective at the end of the current billing period. We've moved to a different tool. Thanks for everything. Workspace ID ws_71552
how do i cancel. i can't find the button anywhere and there's no phone number

subject: Turn off auto-renew
body: Hi, I'd like to make sure my annual plan doesn't renew automatically next March. I'm not sure yet whether I'll continue, and I'd rather decide then. Can you turn off auto-renew for now? Email: tomas.hruby@seznam.cz

subject: Cancellation request - Hartwell & Co
body:
Dear Support,

Following an internal review of our software spending, we have decided not to continue our subscription beyond the current term, which ends on 30 November. Please treat this email as formal notice of cancellation and confirm in writing that no further charges will be made.

We would also appreciate guidance on how long our data will remain accessible after the term ends, as we need to complete an export first.

Kind regards,
Margaret Hartwell
Director, Hartwell & Co Chartered Accountants
Account: acct_hw0211
cancel my plan today please. it's too expensive for what I use. and I'm not going to do a survey about why

subject: Cancel but keep free account
body: I want to cancel my paid Pro plan but keep using the free plan. Will my projects still be there? I have about 15 projects, I think the free plan allows 5. What happens to the other 10?

subject: Cancel trial before it converts
body: My trial converts to paid in 2 days. I don't want to continue. How do I make sure I'm not charged? I don't see a cancel button on the trial banner.

Hi! I'm trying to cancel but every time I click "Cancel plan" it takes me to a page offering 50% off and then back to the billing page. I've clicked "No thanks, cancel anyway" three times and it still says Active. Can you just cancel it from your end? robyn.okafor@hotmail.co.uk

subject: Cancelling our team plan
body: We're a design agency of 7 people. Business is slow and we're cutting costs, so we're cancelling our Team plan. The team is sad about it, we really liked the product. If things pick up next year we'll probably come back. Please confirm the cancellation and let me know how to export our boards first. Workspace pixel-and-pine.ourapp.com

subject: Stop renewing
body: Stop the renewal please. Account acct_rr8q02. That's all.

I cancelled last month (got an email saying it was cancelled) but today I see my plan is still showing as active with a renewal date next week. Is it cancelled or not? I don't want to be charged again.

subject: Cancel one workspace subscription
body: We have two paid workspaces. We want to cancel the subscription for "Studio B" but keep "Studio A" active. When I go to billing I only see one subscription. How do I cancel just Studio B?

subject: Cancel after this month
body: Please cancel at the end of this month. We're merging with another company that uses a different tool, so it's nothing to do with you. One question though: can our team keep read-only access for a few weeks after, so we can look things up during the transition?

My husband set up this subscription on our shared card. He passed away in the spring and I'm going through all our subscriptions. I don't know his login. Can you please cancel it? The card ends in 8812 and the charges say OURAPP*SUBSCR. I'm not sure what else you need.

subject: Cancel + delete data
body: Cancel my subscription and delete all my data after the billing period ends. I don't want anything kept. Email: kai.lindgren@gmail.com

subject: Cancelling due to price increase
body: I just got the email that my plan is going from $8 to $12 a month. That's a 50% increase and I don't use any of the new features you're justifying it with. Please cancel my subscription. If there's a legacy price option I'd stay, but otherwise I'm done.
Is there a way to cancel just the extra storage add-on and keep the rest of our plan? We cleaned up our files and don't need it anymore.

subject: Please don't renew
body: Our renewal is on the 28th. We won't be renewing. I've tried to turn off auto-renew in billing settings but the toggle doesn't stay off when I refresh the page. Please make sure it's off from your side. Org ID 51022.

subject: Cancel - student graduating
body: I'm graduating in June and won't have the student discount anymore, so I'd like to cancel before then. Can I cancel now but keep access until my current month ends?

We need to cancel our subscription immediately and I'm really unhappy. Your app lost 2 days of our work last week and support took 5 days to reply. I'm the owner of workspace bright-cove.ourapp.com. Cancel it now.

subject: Card declined
body: I tried to renew and my card keeps getting declined, but I've used it everywhere else today. Bank says they haven't blocked anything from you. Is there a problem on your end? Account: acct_c0n5v1

subject: Update payment card
body: Our company card was replaced (same account, new number and expiry). How do I update the card on file before our renewal on the 5th?

Got an email saying my payment failed and my account will be downgraded in 3 days. I updated my card straight away but the banner is still there. Did it work? I really can't lose access, I have deadlines this week.

subject: URGENT: account suspended
body: Our entire workspace got suspended this morning for non-payment. Apparently our card expired and the failed payment emails went to our old finance person who left in July. We've got 25 people who can't access anything and a product launch on Friday. I've tried to pay in the billing page but it just says "Payment could not be processed" with every card I try. Please help, I'll pay whatever is owed right now. Workspace: lumen-studios.ourapp.com, invoice INV-63017 is the unpaid one.

subject: Pay by bank transfer?
body: Our finance department doesn't allow card payments for software above a certain amount. Can we switch to paying by bank transfer / invoice for our annual renewal? It's about $6,000. We renew in about 3 weeks.
3D Secure popup never shows up when I try to pay. The payment just spins then fails with "authentication required". Tried Chrome and Safari. My bank app doesn't show any request either.

subject: Payment failed - currency?
body: Our renewal failed. The bank said the transaction was blocked because it was an international charge in USD and our company card only allows domestic transactions in AUD. Can we be billed in AUD instead? Org ID 44508.

subject: PayPal as payment method
body: Can I pay with PayPal instead of a credit card? I don't have a credit card, only debit, and my debit card keeps getting declined on your checkout.
The renewal failed because the company card had a spending limit. We've raised the limit. Can you retry the charge now? We don't want the account to lapse. acct_05lnd4

subject: Can't update card - error
body: When I try to add a new card in the billing page I get "Error PMT-422: card could not be verified". I've tried two different cards from two different banks. Both work fine elsewhere. Our payment is overdue now so this is getting stressful.

subject: Remove old card
body: There's an old expired card still listed in our payment methods. How do I remove it? I've added the new one and made it default, but the old one has no delete option.

Hello. Payment failed for our subscription this month. Our bank says you tried to charge the card 4 times in one day, and they've now frozen the card as a fraud precaution. Please stop retrying. We'll send a new card on Monday. Also can you tell me which invoice this was for? I need it for our records.

subject: Direct debit (SEPA)
body: Do you support SEPA direct debit for payments? We're a German company and card payments are a hassle for our accounting. If yes, how do we switch? Workspace ID W-60917

subject: Payment method for a client
body: I manage the workspace for a client (I'm a consultant). They want to put their own company card on the account instead of me paying and reinvoicing. How can they add their card without getting full admin access?
my payment failed and now i'm locked out of editing, only view mode. i updated the card 10 min ago. how long until i can edit again? i'm in the middle of a project for a client

subject: Card expiring next month
body: Just a heads up that the card on our account expires at the end of next month. I'll update it when the new one arrives. Is there a grace period if the renewal happens before I get a chance?

subject: Billing page won't load
body: When I click on Billing in the admin settings, it's just an endless spinner. I need to update our payment method because the last charge failed. Other admin pages work fine. Chrome, Mac. Workspace: acorn-labs.ourapp.com

Our payment keeps failing and the error in the billing page says "do_not_honor". The card is fine, we used it an hour ago. What does that mean on your end? Also our account says it will be suspended on the 12th. Please don't do that, we're working on it.

subject: Payment failed + need invoice copy
body: Our automatic payment failed on the 1st. I've now updated the card and paid manually. Could you please send me the invoice for that payment? Our accounts team needs it and I can't find it in the billing history. Account acct_n7x0ez.

subject: Invoice copy
body: Could you send me copies of our invoices from January to June? Our accountant needs them for our tax return and I can only download the last 3 from the billing page. Workspace ID ws_14782.
Please add our VAT number to all future invoices: GB 294 8816 03. Company name: Thornbury Analytics Ltd. Thank you.

subject: Invoice needs PO number
body: Our procurement system rejects invoices without a PO number. Could you reissue invoice INV-62104 with PO number 4500128833 on it, and add that PO to all future invoices for the year?

subject: Billing address change
body: We moved offices. Please update the billing address on our invoices to: 14 Waterloo Place, Edinburgh EH1 3EG, United Kingdom. The old address is still showing on the latest invoice. acct_ed1n42
Can you send a W-9 form? Our AP department won't pay new vendors without one on file.

subject: Receipt for personal expense claim
body: I paid for my subscription personally and need to claim it back from my employer. The receipt I get only says "Pro plan" without my name or the period covered. Is there a more detailed receipt I can download? My email is j.odhiambo@gmail.com

subject: Invoice in company name, not mine
body: All our invoices show my personal name instead of our company name. Our accountant can't use them like that. Can you change the name on the invoices to "Kestrel Engineering Pty Ltd" and reissue the last 6? The invoices go back to INV-55812.
Where can I download invoices? The Billing page just shows the plan and next charge date. I'm the admin. I need last month's for our books.

subject: Send invoices to finance email
body: Invoices currently go to my email, but I'd like them to also go to accounts@birchwoodpartners.com automatically. Is it possible to add a second billing contact? I'm going on leave and don't want them to get lost.

subject: Quote for purchase order
body: Before we can pay, our procurement team needs a formal quote on your letterhead for 50 Business seats, annual billing, with our company details. We're Aldermoor Health NHS Trust. Who can prepare this? The quote needs to be valid for 60 days.

The invoice total and the amount charged to our card are different. Invoice INV-61992 says $1,188.00 but our card was charged $1,188.00 plus a $35 foreign transaction fee. I assume the fee is from our bank, not you? Just want to confirm before I explain it to our finance team.

subject: Tax ID for India
body: We are a company registered in India. Please add our GSTIN 27AAACR5055K1Z5 to our billing profile and include it on invoices so we can claim input tax credit. Our workspace is ananta-tech.ourapp.com.

subject: Annual statement
body: For our audit we need a statement of all payments made to you in the last financial year (April to March). Is there a way to download a statement rather than individual invoices? Org ID 38821.
hey could you resend the invoice from the 1st? i accidentally deleted the email. INV-63388 i think

subject: Invoice language
body: Is it possible to get our invoices in French? Our accounting firm in Quebec requires French-language invoices. Everything else in English is fine.

subject: Credit note needed
body: You refunded $240 to us last week for the seats we removed, thank you. For our accounts I need a formal credit note referencing the original invoice (INV-60775). The refund confirmation email isn't enough for our auditors.

Our company's legal name changed after a merger. Old: Brightway Consulting LLC, new: Brightway Meridian Group LLC. Can you update the billing name going forward and reissue this year's invoices in the new name? Account acct_bm7702.

subject: Invoice missing line items
body: Our latest invoice just says "Subscription - $2,340" with no breakdown. Can you send a version that shows the number of seats, per-seat price and any add-ons? Our CFO wants to reconcile it against our seat count.

subject: Invoice + plan change
body: Hello, two things: 1) can you resend invoice INV-62890, I can't find it, and 2) we'd like to move from monthly to annual starting next month. Are there any discounts for switching? Workspace ID ws_28841.

subject: Downgrade + seats
body: We're moving from Business down to Pro and reducing from 30 seats to 18 at our renewal next month. Please confirm both changes will happen together and what the new annual price will be. I've also been meaning to ask: does Pro still include the Slack integration?
We cancelled because we thought we were moving to another tool, but the migration fell through. Can we un-cancel? Our plan hasn't ended yet, it ends on the 20th. Workspace: grey-heron.ourapp.com

subject: Cancel plan and refund?
body: I'd like to cancel my subscription. I've been busy with other things and haven't used it in months. Is there any possibility of refunding the last month? Either way, please cancel. Account acct_q8v6ta

subject: Cancel and remove card
body: Please cancel my subscription and remove my card details from your system. I don't want my card stored anywhere after I leave.
We want to cancel but I'm not the owner, the owner is our CEO and he doesn't have time. I'm an admin. Can I cancel on his behalf or does it have to be him?

subject: Payment declined - different card?
body: Our renewal payment was declined and we have 7 days before suspension. I'd like to switch the payment to our other company card, but it's a Mastercard corporate card and I remember your checkout had trouble with those before. Is that fixed? acct_mc8812

subject: Declined + wrong amount
body: Our renewal was declined, which is our fault (card expired). But when I went to pay manually, the amount due was $960 instead of the $720 we normally pay. Did the price change, or is something wrong? We can't pay until we know which amount is right. Invoice INV-63140.
Is there a way to pay for 2 years upfront? Our budget this year has extra and next year is uncertain. Would be good to lock in the price too.

subject: Update card - account suspended
body: I'm trying to update our card but I can't log in to the billing page because the account is suspended for non-payment. Catch-22! How can I pay if I can't get in? My email is oskar.lind@nordvik.no

subject: Invoices for multiple workspaces
body: We have 4 workspaces each billed separately. Our finance team would like one consolidated monthly invoice for all four. Is that possible? The workspace IDs are ws_10021, ws_10022, ws_10040 and ws_10057.
Can I get an invoice for a payment I made 2 years ago? I need it for a grant report. It was around March, my email back then was sophie.durand@univ-lyon2.fr

subject: Tax exemption
body: We're a US 501(c)(3) nonprofit and shouldn't be charged sales tax. I've attached our exemption certificate... actually I can't attach here. Where can I send it so you can update our account and future invoices? Account acct_nfp3390

subject: Add seats before Monday
body: We're onboarding 10 new sales reps on Monday morning and need 10 more seats on our Business plan before then. Also, I noticed our plan says Business (legacy). Is that different from the current Business plan, and should we switch while we're adding seats?
Is my subscription cancelled? I asked in chat last week and the bot said it would be done but I never got an email confirming it and it still shows active. Ticket was #57120 I think.

subject: Can't pay invoice link
body: The payment link in the invoice email (INV-63411) gives "This link has expired". The invoice is due tomorrow. Can you send a new link? We pay by card, not bank transfer.

subject: Invoice showing wrong period
body: Our latest invoice INV-62551 says the service period is June 1 - June 30, but we were charged on July 1 for July. I think the date on the invoice is just wrong. Can you reissue with the correct period? Our auditors are picky about this.

Hello, we would like to change from paying by card to paying by invoice with 30-day terms, and we also need all our invoices addressed to our parent company going forward. Is that something your billing team can set up? We're on Enterprise, Org ID 90044.
